name: q.it core
description: Small offline smoke and retrieval benchmarks for validating edge-model serving paths.

benchmarks.name: Text generation smoke
benchmarks.description: Measures streamed text generation latency and checks simple instruction following.

benchmarks.name: Embedding retrieval
benchmarks.description: Measures embedding latency and checks whether the expected document ranks first by cosine similarity.

benchmarks.name: Image to text smoke
benchmarks.description: Measures vision-language latency with a generated two-color image.

benchmarks.name: Speech to text transport smoke
benchmarks.description: Measures the transcription path with a short generated tone and does not claim speech quality.

benchmarks.name: Reranking relevance
benchmarks.description: Measures reranking latency and checks whether the expected passage is ranked first.

benchmarks.name: Text to image smoke
benchmarks.description: Measures whether an image generation endpoint accepts a small edge-oriented request.
